social.author: Hulk Smash Szn
social.text: 5% to 43% and the game hasn't even scored a point?? Something just happened and I'm choosing to believe it's good. Let's GO No Banner only HULK

social.author: Dawgs Kennel Club
social.text: Kai's win chance just got mugged in broad daylight at 0-0. Someone check the Dawgs' pulse.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: No Banner only HULK jumping from 5% to 43% before a single point is a big lineup-status swing. Still short of a coin flip, but the model just stopped laughing.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Worth watching the No Banner only HULK vs Dawgs game closely. A swing that size at 0-0 usually means something changed in who's active.

social.author: Windy City Waiver Watch
social.text: Randy dropped Jaylin Noel after 0.7 points. Dropping a guy is easy, Randy. Trading one is the part he's never learned.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers have cut Jaylin Noel loose and he's a free agent. Managers needing WR depth will have a look. Not a surprise after a 0.7-point week.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Randy cutting Noel is a LOCK to be the right call, and I won't hear otherwise. Anyone who grabs him is chasing ghosts.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Team Pillbert jumping from 26% to 49% at 0-0 means the lineup picture changed in a big way. The model now treats this one as a coin flip against The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Philly out here rebuilding his roster at the last second like it's a heist movie. Two TE swaps and a QB pickup before kickoff, and somehow the win chance is up 23 points. I hate it here.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert (Alan) picked up Chig Okonkwo and dropped Keon Coleman, who had 21.1 points over three weeks. That's a notable cut for a tight end who has yet to score.

social.author: Windy City Waiver Watch
social.text: Randy added Tre Tucker off waivers after cutting Noel. Fine, a waiver claim isn't a trade, so the streak lives.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Ghostu-Spider SZN (Zoe) has cut Jaylen Waddle, 50.9 points over seven weeks, and picked up rookie WR KC Concepcion, who has no points yet. That's a bold swap on a week 8 morning.

social.author: Web Slinger Wire
social.text: Z² dropping Waddle for a guy with zero points?? Either she sees something or we're all about to find out. Locked in or lost in the sauce, no in between.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Kicker Butker getting dropped by JMoney is a LOCK to haunt him by Sunday night. Nobody cuts a kicker and walks away clean, I've been burned before.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the Kennel, Falcons D/ST! Ravens D/ST, thanks for the 28 points.

social.author: Hulk Smash Report
social.text: Golden catches one for 10.5 and Brucie's squad is on the board before Dawgs even wake up. Coin-flip game, but the green guys are already throwing the first punch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Golden's 10.5 puts No Banner only HULK at 51% against Dawgs, with Mekhi still at zero. One play moved this to a true toss-up, and Luffy is just watching it happen.

social.author: No Banner only HULK
social.text: Matthew Golden is up and running: 10.5 points and counting. HULK leads Dawgs early.
